Trusted matching R5 numerical proposal after completed/drained encoder epoch

resource_policy.owner: R5 runtime; trusted initialization before lease
resource_policy.linux: No direct access; use separate mailbox/status interface
resource_policy.enforcement: Requester filter before full-AXI to Lite conversion, protected config/reset/bypass

resource_policy.owner: Trusted loader before seal; R5/encoder according to buffer direction afterward
resource_policy.linux: No writes during owned service, including every Linux-controlled DMA path
resource_policy.enforcement: Boot allocation plus applicable PS XMPU/XPPU/TZ and verified external TCM coverage

resource_policy.owner: Bounded transport with immutable/private input snapshot; local PL result authoritative
resource_policy.linux: Submit input; read result copy; no raw authoritative ACK/proposal writes

resource_policy.resource: R5/PL clocks, reset, TCM power, critical PLLs, DDR config, AFI, CSU and protection configuration
resource_policy.linux: Only proved-disjoint resource/argument operations; no broad MMIO or IOCTL escape
resource_policy.enforcement: Selective PMU/secure policy, direct-MMIO protection, reset/PSCI and configuration-lock review

resource_policy.linux: Keep required network/controller resources active; DMA restricted to private memory

boot_lifecycle.diagnostic_alternative: Cooperative Linux remoteproc load; Linux remains trusted and no enforced-exclusion claim
